'''Hyper Tools''' was a hardware store<ref name="Faster" /> on the [[planet]] [[Serolonis]].<ref name="Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/faster-episode-guide|text="Faster" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}}</ref>. An [[Aurebesh]] advertisement at the [[Safa Toma Speedway]] was used to market it. It showed the business logo above a pair of tools, and included the text "SUPER <small>''[illegible]''</small>" and "BUY SOON."<ref name="Faster" />
